title: Dry-Week Completion Rate
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vice:log habit=dry_week
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as attempts, sum(eval(if(completed="true",1,0))) as completed by _time
| eval completion_pct=round(100*completed/attempts,0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how often an intended dry week is completed rather than abandoned halfway through.
value: Success rate is more honest than good intentions and shows whether the goal is actually sustainable.
implementation: Log dry-week attempts and outcomes in `index=personal`; summarize monthly attempt and completion rates.
visualization: Monthly column chart of dry-week attempts versus completions.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how often your planned dry weeks actually make it to the finish line instead of fading halfway through.
